summary.headline: Tables of Zodiacal Degrees
summary.text: Tables of dark, bright, stationary, solid, and other planetary degrees attributed to the philosophers, arranged by the twelve zodiac signs. A second table distinguishes masculine and feminine degrees, marking masculine in black and feminine in red.
